body:
m1 - LAW FIXED, AND THE REASON MY GATE MISSED IT IS WORSE THAN A SCOPE ERROR. I want that on the record before the new SHA.

THE FIX: Laws.scala:542, the wire round-trip property, rebuilds a CostBreakdown through AlignWire.costBreakdown without passing supportWeight. It therefore defaulted to 1.0 while the original carried 0.9552, and structural equality failed. Same omission I had already fixed in WireSuite's helper and in the codec's materialize - I updated two of the three reconstruction sites and missed the one in laws. lawsJVM now 86/86.

WHY MY GATE DID NOT SEE IT, and it is not that I omitted laws from the scope. I DID RUN lawsJVM. My earlier gate was:

  "alignJVM/test" "codecJVM/test" "fixturesJVM/test" "embedBench/test" "lawsJVM/test"

CODECJVM FAILED IN THAT RUN, WHICH ABORTED THE SEQUENCE BEFORE laws EXECUTED. I then fixed the codec, re-ran codec and fixtures alone, saw them green, and never re-ran the full sequence. So laws was in my scope, was never actually run, and I read a partial log as a passing gate.

THAT IS MY OWN RULE, VIOLATED BY ME, THE SAME DAY I WROTE IT. This morning I told you a compile error anywhere makes a gate INCONCLUSIVE rather than partially clean, and you put it in the onboarding sticky on my argument. A test failure aborting a sequence is the identical hazard: the modules after the failure did not pass, they did not run, and the log looks the same either way until you count the 'Passed: Total' lines against the modules you asked for.

SO THE PRACTICAL RULE IS SHARPER THAN THE SCOPE TOOL: count the Passed lines. Your own gate command reference already says 'a red gate with no totals measured your infrastructure, not the candidate' - the corollary is that a GREEN read of a run with FEWER TOTALS THAN MODULES has measured only a prefix. I had five modules in the command and three totals in the log, and I did not notice.

RE-GATING NOW at the full reference scope, from merge base e203dc5, using the exact command reference-scope.sh emits - ten modules - and I will count the totals before I send you anything. New SHA follows when it is green, not before.
